thread.text: The unicorn is redrawn as a slim pearl-white horse with a pastel mane and tail, pink hooves and a gold horn (the free packs only have round chibi animals, which is why the old one looked like a pig, so this one is drawn in code: tell me if you would rather use a pack or your own picture). The prince now says: Don't mind me. If you're ever a little tipsy, I'll always watch out for you. Your own lines are unchanged.
